answer: Bind each voting seat to a bonded winery holding a federal TTB permit. The permit names one premises, the owner passes a background check, and the seat's key is filed beside the registry number, so one licensed cellar backs one seat. Tax bonds, inspections and fees cost about $3,000 a year, so 600 sybil seats would cost an attacker roughly $1.8M yearly. A real orchard or vineyard, cedar barrels and monthly excise reports form a trail no script can fake, even one run from a summit data center.
